dailyTip: Write a paste-ready report from today's commits and uncommitted files

agent.noRepo: This level needs a repo: pick one at the top left, or open a repo on the Git page.

permission.readDesc: Reads files, searches, checks git; changes nothing
permission.workspaceDesc: Edits files in the repo; asks before commands
permission.reviewDesc: AI checks each action first; asks you when risky
permission.fullDesc: Edits files and runs commands without asking
permission.shortcutHint: Ctrl+. cycles the first three levels
permission.placeholderWrite: What should I do? (Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline)
permission.fullConfirmBody: At this level the AI edits files, runs commands and launches apps without asking you.
permission.fullConfirmWarn: Dangerous commands (force push, hard reset, format…) and the stay-inside-the-repo rule still apply at every level. Use it only for tasks you trust.

focusEmpty: No repos yet — scan a folder
focusScanEmpty: No git repos found in that folder
bubbleTip: AI Hub · click to open · drag to snap · right-click to close

taskPlaceholder.none: Ask something… (Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline)
taskPlaceholder.debug: Paste an error or log to diagnose with project context…
taskPlaceholder.explain: Paste code, a command or a concept to explain…

chipTip.workspace: Project mode: attach repo list and current branches
chipTip.git: Project mode: attach current Git user name and email
chipTip.dirty: Project mode: attach uncommitted changes of the selected repos

ctx.title: Choose project context
ctx.selectAll: Select the whole workspace (services added later are included too)
ctx.note: These are only sent in Project mode.
ctx.previewEmpty: No project context to attach right now
ctx.includeOff: No project context · click to include
ctx.includeLocked: This level changes the repo, so {{name}} is always included

reason.override: Set by hand, next message only
reason.meta: A question about the assistant itself — answered as chat
reason.textTask: Text task — no project information needed
reason.signal: Mentions code, errors or paths — project context attached
reason.followUp: Follow-up to the previous project question
reason.default: No project cues — answered as chat
